dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent irregular polygonal and circular closed rings concentrated on the mid-dorsal and lateral regions. The perimeter of these structures shows a sharp high-contrast gradient transition from dark charcoal exterior to a light-grey/cream boundary, enclosing a darker grey interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, low-intensity dark spots lacking internal gradients, primarily observed in the neck region and in the inter-annuli spaces along the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest edge oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined set of five elongated, dark-pigmented claws on the visible fore-flipper, displaying sharp point geometry and clear inter-digit separation.
